page.layout: One printed page: running head line at top (page number left, letter Z centred); then a block of italic text in full lines; a centred heading FINIS.; a woodcut of a fruit basket; below it a catchword-like heading INDEX cut off at the right edge.

p.i: Bab. Schabbat fol. 23. 2. Qui de candela Sabbatica curat, fituri sunt eius filii discipuli Sapientum; qui de membranulis postibus affigendis, domum speciosam adipiscetur: quique de ציצית fimbriis vestimento attexendis, adipiscetur bonam tunicam.

page.notes: The woodcut (a basket of flowers and fruit on a footed vase) is not transcribed. The Hebrew word in the italic text is printed as "ציצית" (tsitsit); the letters are read from the scan and may be imperfect. The word at the bottom right is cut off at the edge and reads "INDEX" only partly; it is given as the likely word. Show-through and stains are omitted.
